note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(健康生活主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: After putting on weight during a busy exam month, Tom decided to take charge of his health. He swapped late-night soda for water, took a short walk after each dinner, and went to bed an hour earlier. A few weeks later, he felt lighter, slept better, and had far more energy for his lessons.

questions.q: What made Tom decide to change his habits?
options: He had put on extra weight while exams kept him busy.
His doctor told him to move house.
He wanted to win a running race.
His friends laughed at his cooking.
questions.explanation: 原文 'After putting on weight during a busy exam month' 的转述;其余未提或与文意不符。

questions.q: How did Tom feel a few weeks later?
options: More tired and anxious than before.
Bored with all his new habits.
Sorry that he had started at all.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt lighter, slept better, and had far more energy'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的概括。
